finding: From 2021 to 2025, about 3,400 people walking or biking were killed or seriously hurt on Chicago streets; 273 of them died. 44% of them were hurt in 58 clusters, along about 140 miles of streets.

ledger.source: Traffic Crashes - People; Traffic Crashes - Crashes
ledger.units: 3,366 people walking or biking, killed or seriously injured, 2021-2025
method: KSI: injury classification fatal or incapacitating (SR 1050 K and A), as recorded by police
HDBSCAN on positions in meters, leaf selection, minimum cluster 12, min samples 6
Kept: clusters that hold in resampling (stability 0.5 or more, 200 refits on 80% samples)
Shapes: the streets joining each cluster's people (minimum spanning tree of network distances on OSM streets)
HIN: CDOT 2025 corridors drawn on OpenStreetMap streets (2026-11-01); a person is on it within 75 ft
caveats: Counts, not rates: no citywide counts of people walking or biking exist
Police-reported crashes on CPD streets only; expressways excluded
Deaths from CDOT Vision Zero list (30-day rule); serious injuries as police recorded them
